title: Parts, Glass and Component Price List — CareLine Service Plans
content:
Parts counter prices for the CareLine Service Plans family. Parts used in a repair are priced at the published parts price less the tier's parts discount. A sealed glass unit replaced outside warranty is a flat charge per unit with parts and labor included. Weatherstripping, screen mesh and exterior caulk are priced per opening or per screen.

### Parts and glass

| Tier | Discount on the published parts price | Flat charge per sealed glass unit replaced outside warranty, parts and labor included (USD) | Business days from order to installed replacement glass |
|---|---|---|---|
| On-Call Service Account | 0% (0.00) | 289.00 | 15 |
| CareLine Basic Plan | 10% (0.10) | 275.00 | 12 |
| CareLine Plus Plan | 15% (0.15) | 259.00 | 10 |
| CareLine Premier Plan | 20% (0.20) | 245.00 | 7 |
| CareLine Premier 3-Year Plan | 20% (0.20) | 245.00 | 7 |
| CareLine Estate Plan | 25% (0.25) | 229.00 | 5 |

### Weatherstripping, rescreening and caulk

| Tier | Replace weatherstripping, per opening (USD) | Replace screen mesh, per screen (USD) | Remove and replace exterior caulk, per opening (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| On-Call Service Account | 59.00 | 45.00 | 39.00 |
| CareLine Basic Plan | 49.00 | 39.00 | 35.00 |
| CareLine Plus Plan | 39.00 | 39.00 | 29.00 |
| CareLine Premier Plan | 0.00 (included) | 0.00 (included) | 25.00 |
| CareLine Premier 3-Year Plan | 0.00 (included) | 0.00 (included) | 25.00 |
| CareLine Estate Plan | 0.00 (included) | 0.00 (included) | 19.00 |

A charge of 0.00 marks work included in the plan: on the CareLine Premier Plan, the CareLine Premier 3-Year Plan and the CareLine Estate Plan weatherstripping and rescreening are included, while exterior caulk resealing is charged on every tier.

### Worked figures (hypothetical published prices)

| Hypothetical item | Tier | Price charged |
|---|---|---|
| A part with a published price of 80.00 | CareLine Basic Plan | 80.00 less 10%, that is 72.00 |
| A part with a published price of 80.00 | CareLine Estate Plan | 80.00 less 25%, that is 60.00 |
| A part with a published price of 80.00 | On-Call Service Account | 80.00 (no discount) |
| Exterior caulk resealed at 3 openings | CareLine Plus Plan | 3 openings multiplied by 29.00, that is 87.00 |
| Screen mesh replaced on 2 screens | CareLine Basic Plan | 2 screens multiplied by 39.00, that is 78.00 |
| One sealed glass unit replaced outside warranty | CareLine Premier Plan | 245.00, parts and labor included |

### Points of reading

**Is labor added to the sealed glass unit charge?** No. The flat charge per sealed glass unit already includes parts and labor.

**What does the discount act on?** The published parts price of each part used in a repair.
